full_objective.ranking: all within-case observed/unobserved pairs exactly once per epoch
full_objective.donor: one fixed train-only donor per case; independent of observation class
full_objective.reference: both sides live; no detached ranking-reference embeddings
full_objective.auxiliary: global balanced CE; inverse schedule multiplicity per observation
full_objective.normalization: epoch objective: global pair mean and global balanced observation mean
full_objective.selection_metric: MRR then R@1 then negative pairwise loss
full_objective.query_scope: all observations; retain cases without eligible positive
full_objective.support: unchanged patient support and L2 policy

comparison.teacher_scope: fresh own-branch eval-support plan; no exact recreation of saved production teacher or RNG update
limitations: Multiple reference operator and initialization changes remain; no single-factor causal attribution
One same-tile BN pass is neither validated calibration nor trained running statistics
Tile pair-win/spread are diagnostic values, not full-case MRR or CP accuracy
A detached-query gradient probe does not independently measure CNN parameter gradients

native_tile_binding.selection: first deterministic complete-schedule tile; no saved next optimization tile available in this phase

input_contract.candidate_subset: explicit diagnostic cases; every candidate retained
input_contract.case_selection: fixed sorted spread of cases with both P/U, independent of model scores; cases without positives remain in the complete training schedule
input_contract.support: saved detached epoch L0; unchanged episode selection during updates; full eligible support during evaluation
